item.title: The Five Minute Read – Lowell man wins $1M
item.description: The Five Minute Read highlights things to do, places to go and people to know in the Greater Lowell area. Have news to share? Send it to news@lowellsun.com. Submissions must be received at least one week in advance to be considered for publication. Submitted photographs should be at least 300 KB in JPG format.

item.title: Wednesday’s high school roundup: Tewksbury/Methuen girls hockey team wins league title
item.description: Balanced scoring, tight defense and solid goaltending paid off again for the Tewksbury/Methuen girls hockey team Wednesday. The Red Rangers clinched the Merrimack Valley Conference/Dual County League title thanks to a 4-1 victory over Shrewsbury. item.title: Hopkinton boys, Westford Academy girls win Div. 2 indoor track titles
item.description: The stakes got very high heading into the 4x400 meter relay. Concord-Carlisle held a slim lead over Hopkinton in the standings and a strong finish in the third heat of the event put the pressure on the Hillers 'A' team to get the job done.

item.title: Editorial: Time has come to graduate with a 3-year degree
item.description: Sticker shock now runs rampant through this country’s higher education system. It might be just an annoyance, such as being forced to pay a fee to gain access to course materials like electronic textbooks, or outlandish, like the updated, astronomical overall price to attend Brown University — $97,016 — for one academic year.
